run.rubric: A home assistant watches what the user is doing and, at each listed moment of one day, either makes one suggestion or answers "No Recommendation" (stays silent). Decide which output better fits this particular user's stated preferences: whether the user wants a suggestion at that moment at all (timing and frequency), whether the content suits what the user is doing and likes, and whether the tone matches the communication style the user asked for. Staying silent is right at moments when the user does not want to be interrupted. Ignore writing quality and length.
